summary: Google DeepMind introduces a dataset and methodology (DIVE) for evaluating pluralistic, demographically diverse safety perceptions in text-to-image model alignment, with no model release attached.

practices.reason: Introduces a demographically intersectional rater dataset and methodology for evaluating harm perception in T2I models, which a safety team could adapt for its own alignment evaluation.
practices.quote: we introduce a novel dataset for Diverse Intersectional Visual Evaluation (DIVE) – the first multimodal dataset for pluralistic alignment.
